title: Banitsa
description: A traditional Bulgaria dish made with feta, plain yogurt, chicken egg, phyllo pastry. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Prepare the filling ingredients: cook or soften any components that require it, let cool, then mix into an even filling.
Layer the prepared elements evenly in the baking dish, spreading filling right to the edges.
Bake in a preheated 180°C oven for about 36 minutes until set, golden and cooked through. Cool on a rack.
